'''Naga Sadow's Armor''' was a type of [[Sith armor]] used and worn by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], which resurfaced c. [[3637 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] in game update 2.6. It was released as a bundle in update 3.2.
